provenance.description: The measured resolution of the WALK-FORWARD path across its own window configurations, on the synthetic positive-control fixture, at one sample size (10,000 bars) x three seeds x both series x seven (train_months, test_months) configurations. The step follows the test window, so the out-of-sample windows tile the sample without overlapping. Every number in each row is the framework's own block (summary['test_resolution'] and the Deflated Sharpe / Deflated Alpha blocks it was built from), read by scripts/measure_resolution_vs_sample_size.py; the row also carries the framework's own count of how many of the windows could price the strategy at all (n_periods, periods_with_position). This is a measurement of the decision machinery on a synthetic control -- a formula, not a market -- and never evidence about a security. No threshold, plausibility bound, criterion or verdict is changed by it.

fixture_construction.purpose: TEST-MACHINERY CHECK ON SYNTHETIC DATA: a series produced by a known formula, used to check that the falsifiable-hypothesis machinery can return SUPPORTED. It is not evidence about any security or market.

measured.step: follows the test window (non-overlapping out-of-sample windows)

provenance.note: The companion sweep of the SAME measurement at 5,000 bars is not committed here; the reference document quotes its numbers and the capture for the 10,000-bar sweep is the pinned one.
